answer: Quote a TEE measurement with every receipt, verify the quote against the vendor root, and reject anything unsigned. Tax attestations where more than half the signers resolve to one subnet. Assume the attacker breaks one enclave: rotate the measurement set each epoch so a leaked cipher expires with the old image. Cost per clone is one real enclave plus a fresh quote, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 enclaves. That closes the inlet of cheap virtualization, and every stale quote turns umber in the log before it stops paying at close.
